description.en:
The culprit of a mysterious murder case, a boy with the heart of a dead lover.


In the near future, Vega City, a city-state with advanced biotechnology. A horrific murder occurs in which a researcher is shot in the face and dies. The victim's son, Doil, who was identified as the culprit, left an unknown statement that he saw a monster, and even the autopsy's doctor disappeared, and the case gradually falls into a labyrinth. several years after that. Detective assistant and bodyguard Ethan, who is chasing the truth of the case, encounters Doil through an anonymous tip, and learns that his dead lover Eve's heart has been transplanted to him like a joke of fate.

While Ethan and Doil are concerned about each other, they have a gut feeling that something unusual is hidden behind the murder case. When the opportunity comes again, they come together to uncover the truth of the incident and face the shocking truth of Vega City...

What is the identity of the monster that killed Doil's mother? Was it a coincidence that he had Eve's heart?

description.ru:
Круа Аложе — злодейка и статистка из романа 19+ «Три герцогских дома». Переродившись в этом мире, она получает приказ соблазнить и уничтожить герцога Диелло Аржента.
Под маской ложной судьбоносной пары Круа должна разрушить его семью. Но чтобы избежать печальной участи оригинала, она предлагает врагу сделку:

«Давай поженимся. Всего на год.»

Так начинается их контрактный брак — ради взаимной выгоды и безопасности герцога. Они изображают страстных супругов, скрывая свои истинные цели.
Но когда срок договора подходит к концу и Круа планирует исчезнуть, Диелло раскрывает свою истинную сущность: «Я думал, вы умны. Почему же знаете одно, но не понимаете другого?..»

Сможет ли Круа сбежать от сладкой и опасной одержимости герцога?

description.en: Lee Minwoo, who suffers from a congenital heart disease, spends his days not wanting to live, yet not wanting to die either. One day, a red dust covered the city. People who breathed in the dust vomited blood and went mad, and unknown red plants began to grow on their bodies, blooming and spreading seeds. In a world full of infected individuals, outlaws, and numerous dangers, the true identity of the parasitic plants is gradually revealed. Minwoo, who couldn't find meaning in life, struggles to survive amidst many sacrifices and hopes.
description.pt-br: Lee Minwoo, que sofre de uma doença cardíaca congênita, passa os dias sem querer viver, mas também sem querer morrer. Um dia, uma poeira vermelha cobriu a cidade. As pessoas que inalaram a poeira vomitaram sangue e enlouqueceram, e plantas vermelhas desconhecidas começaram a crescer em seus corpos, elas floresceram e espalharam sementes. No mundo cheio de infectados, bandidos e muitos perigos, a verdadeira identidade das plantas parasitas é gradualmente revelada. Minwoo, que não encontrava sentido na vida, luta para sobreviver entre muitos sacrifícios e esperanças.

description.de: Ein magisches Land, in dem es von blauen Glühwürmchen wimmelt, und Refugia, eine streng kontrollierte Stadt, die völlig von der Magie abgeschottet ist. Eines Tages entdecken neugierige Mädchen aus Refugia in einer Bibliothek ein geheimnisvolles altes Buch und eine rote Halskette. Ohne zu wissen, was sich in ihrem Besitz befindet, folgen sie neugierig den blauen Glühwürmchen aus der Stadt und überschreiten dabei Grenzen, die noch nie zuvor jemand überschritten haben. Mit Hilfe des legendären Crimson Hearts und der geheimnisvollen Botschaft „Befreie die Insel der Blauen Glühwürmcheninsel von ihrem Fluch“ wagen sie sich tiefer in das Unbekannte und entdecken das Geheimnis von Refugia und die Wahrheit hinter den blauen Glühwürmchen. Was für Herausforderungen erwarten die Mädchen aus Refugia?
description.en: The Unknown, a magical land teeming with blue fireflies, and Refugia, a highly-controlled city completely walled off from magic. One day inquisitive girls from Refugia discover a mysterious old book and a red necklace in a library. Without knowing what is in their possession, they curiously follow the blue fireflies out of the city, crossing barriers that no one has ever crossed before. With the help of the legendary Crimson Heart and a mysterious message, “Break the curse of Blue Firefly Island,” they venture deeper into the Unknown uncovering the secret of Refugia and the truth behind the blue fireflies. What lies ahead for the girls from Refugia?
description.es: El corazón escarlata. El legado de las cadenas de Refugia. Lo supe desde el momento en que lo descubrí. Así se abrió paso a un gran y misterioso destino.
description.fr: La terre magique dérive sous l'effet de la «luciole bleue.» Tandis que la ville complètement contrôlée et à l'abri de cette malédiction, Refugia connaît une vie «parfaite.» Les jeunes filles qui n'avaient connu qu'une vie encadrée par ce système, découvrent un jour un livre ancien et un collier avec un pendentif rouge. Sans savoir la nature de ces objets mais curieuses de découvrir la luciole bleue, elles traversent le mur que personne n'avait osé dépasser auparavant. Ayant en leur possession le légendaire «Crimson Heart» et le message mystérieux qui demande de «lever la malédiction de l'île de la luciole bleue,» elles se lancent dans une aventure. Dans leur parcours, elles découvrent peu à peu les secrets de Refugia et la vérité sur la luciole bleue. Quel destin les attend au bout de ce voyage? Crimson Heart avec Le Sserafim
description.id: Unknown, sebuah wilayah yang dipenuhi sihir, menjadi kacau karena kunang-kunang biru. Di sisi lain dari Unknown, terdapat sebuah kota yang dikontrol secara penuh bernama Refugia. Suatu hari, para gadis yang diatur oleh sistem Refugia menemukan buku kuno dan kalung merah di perpustakaan. Tanpa menyadari apa yang di dalam tangan mereka, mereka melewati tembok penghalang Refugia yang tak pernah dilewati oleh siapapun dan ke luar dari kota setelah melihat kunang-kunang biru yang membuat mereka penasaran Berbekal dengan Crimson Heart, kalung legendaris di tangan mereka, dan pesan misterius yang mengatakan untuk ‘hancurkan kutukan Pulau Kunang-Kunang Biru’. Rahasia Refugia dan kebenaran tentang kunang-kunang biru terungkap semakin lama dalam petualangan mereka di kota misterius, Unknown! Bagaimana nasib para gadis-gadis itu? Ikuti petulangan LE SSERAFIM dalam Crimson Heart!
description.ja: Crimson Heart。 レフュージアに隠された遺産であり足かせでもあった。 それを発見したとき、私は気づいた。 巨大な未知の運命が、今動き始めたと。
description.ko:
'푸른 반딧불이'로 인해 폭주하는 마법의 땅 언노운, 그런 마법으로부터 완전히 차단된 통제도시 레퓨지아 
레퓨지아에서 완벽한 시스템을 통해 관리되며 살아가던 소녀들은 
어느날 도서관에서 의문의 낡은 책과 붉은 목걸이를 발견한다. 
자신들의 손에 쥐어진 것이 무엇인지도 모른 채 
소녀들은 푸른 반딧불이를 보고 호기심에 이끌려 아무도 넘지 않았던 장벽을 넘어 도시 밖으로 나간다 

소녀들의 손에 쥐어진 전설의 크림슨 하트, 
'푸른 반딧불이 섬의 저주를 풀라'는 의문의 메시지. 
미지의 땅 언노운을 모험할수록 밝혀지는 레퓨지아의 비밀과 푸른 반딧불이의 진실 
...소녀들의 운명은? 크림슨 하트 with 르세라핌
description.th: อันโนว์น ดินแดนแห่งเวทมนตร์ที่ล่มสลายไปเพราะ “หิ่งห้อยสีฟ้า” และ เรฟิวเจีย เมืองที่ปิดกั้นเวทมนตร์อันน่าสะพรึงดังกล่าวได้อย่างสมบูรณ์ วันหนึ่งเหล่าเด็กสาวที่เคยอยู่ภายใต้การควบคุมของระบบอันไร้ที่ติในเรฟิวเจีย ได้พบกับหนังสือโบราณลึกลับและสร้อยคอสีแดงฉานในหอสมุด พวกเธอถูกเรื่องราวของหิ่งห้อยสีฟ้าดึงดูด และได้ตัดสินใจที่จะเดินทางออกนอกเมืองผ่านกำแพงที่ไม่เคยมีใครข้ามผ่านมาก่อน โดยที่ไม่รู้เลยว่าสิ่งที่พวกเธอครอบครองอยู่นั้นคืออะไร “คริมสันฮาร์ต” ในตำนานที่เหล่าเด็กสาวครอบครองอยู่ ข้อความลึกลับที่เขียนไว้ว่า “จงถอนคำสาปแห่งเกาะหิ่งห้อยสีฟ้า” รวมถึงความลับของเรฟิวเจียและความจริงของหิ่งห้อยสีฟ้าที่จะถูกเปิดเผยเมื่อพวกเธอออกผจญภัยสู่ดินแดนที่ไม่มีใครรู้จัก ชะตากรรมของพวกเธอคืออะไรกันแน่? เรื่องราวของ “Crimson Heart ร่วมกับ LE SSERAFIM” ได้เริ่มต้นขึ้นแล้ว
description.uk: Невідомість — чарівна країна, кожен куточок якої освітлений блакитними світлячками, вона чудова та прекрасна, ця неймовірна держава. Її місто Рефуґія — під суворим контролем та повністю відгороджене від магії. Одного дня місцеві допитливі дівчатка знаходять у бібліотеці давню книгу з таємничим посланням: «Зніміть прокляття з Острова Блакитних Світлячків», — та намисто, багряне й чіпке. Вони з властивою цікавістю слідують за блакитними світлячками, перетинаючи бар'єри, які ще ніхто ніколи не перетинав, за межі міста. Що криє собою таємниця Рефуґії, що стоїть за блакитними світлячками? Та як далеко зайдуть дівчата, перш ніж їх шлях обірветься.
description.zh:
前往蓝色萤火虫之岛,
冒险的魔法少女们！
因蓝色萤火虫暴走的魔法大陆中最安全的城邦-来弗吉亚。这儿的少女们无意间发现一本旧书和一条项链，好奇心驱使她们走向了外面的世界……传说中的项链与神秘信息，而随着她们的冒险来弗吉亚的秘密与蓝色萤火虫的真相也逐渐浮出水面。她们的命运将会……
description.zh-hk: 因為「藍光螢火蟲」而失控的魔法國度未知之地，以及徹底隔絕了那種魔法、受到控制的都市雷弗吉亞，在雷弗吉亞完美系統管理下長大的少女們，某天在圖書館發現了可疑的舊書和紅色項鍊！連手中物品是什麼都還不清楚的少女們，在看見藍光螢火蟲後，受到好奇心驅使、跨越了不曾有人跨越的堡壘，來到了都市之外......少女們手上那條傳說中的緋紅之心(Crimson Heart)、以及寫著「解開藍光螢火蟲之島的詛咒吧！」的神祕訊息…隨著在未知之地的冒險展開，雷弗吉亞的祕密及藍光螢火蟲的真相也呼之欲出！…少女們的命運會是如何呢？ Crimson Heart with LE SSERAFIM

biography.en:
HYBE is a Korean Entertainment company used to be know as Big Hit Entertainment before changing their name.

They are in collaboration with LINE WEBTOON for webtoon series base on their kpop groups under them such as BTS, TXT, ENHYPHEN, Le Sserafim, and &Team.

description.en: When the hot-tempered Han Hye Won accidently insults the handsome jjang of Han Hwa Go, Sunwoo Bin decides to pay her a visit… with his entire motorcycle gang, ready to see some blood. So how does that lead up to a kiss and the infamous captain begging for a date? Do you want to try?

description.en:
After his mother is murdered by an unknown assailant who leaves no trace, the protagonist tries to use his ability to turn back time to prevent the tragedy—but fails every time. Before her death, his mother warns him: “If you ever see someone who looks exactly like me, never pretend to know them.”

As the world descends into chaos due to time travelers, a fierce battle erupts between those trying to stop time travel and those determined to protect it.

description.en: After a cataclysm rocks the world causing humans and animals to perish in large numbers, those left behind work to restore the land. The sage Mannaz is tasked with decontaminating a poisoned forest but quits before the job is fully finished and leaves his disciple Baum to look after things in his stead. When the handsome knight Pera comes in search of Mannaz and only finds Baum in the sage's home, he resolves to wait there until Mannaz returns. With this new unexpected housemate, Baum's life is about to get a lot more interesting.

Yeongi is the top student in her grade. But her kind and responsible exterior masks problems at home. Her dad is gone, her mom is gravely ill, and she has to live with her new caretaker, the imposing Chairman. Now she has to keep an eye on his troublemaker son, Pyeong. When the Chairman promises Yeongi he’ll grant her one wish if she’s elected school president, Yeongi works hard to balance school life, dealing with bullies, and a potential romance while trying to figure Pyeong out.
description.ko:
“이 집에서 벗어나는 게 네 소원이야?”

하루 아침에 모든 걸 들고 사라진 아빠와,

이런 현실을 부정하듯 쓰러져버린 엄마.

그런 영이에게 온기를 나눠준 유일한 사람이자 엄마의 오랜 친구,

회장님이 없었다면 지금의 장영이는 존재 하지 않는다고 굳게 믿었다.

하지만 회장님이 없었다면,

아무런 일도 일어나지 않았을 거란 사실을 알게 된 날.

영이는 회장의 마수에서 벗어나기 위해

수 겹의 가면을 쓰고 악연인지도 모른 채 피어난

평이에 대한 마음에 자물쇠를 채워 버렸다.

우린 인연일까, 악연일까 <어떤 사이>

description.en: After nine college students are trapped under a collapsed building for 14 days, only six come out alive, and only four of them can speak. The dead bodies of their fellow students are viciously mangled, leading police to investigate the case as a possible homicide. Detective Lieutenants Jeongdo Kwon and Yeongchae Shin, together with renowned neuropsychiatrist Dr. Yeongwha Ju, must parse through witness testimony and inconclusive physical evidence to uncover the truth. But how do you solve a locked-room murder case when every witness is a suspect?
description.ko:
건물붕괴 사고로 매몰된 9명의 대학생.
2주 뒤, 3명은 사망하고 1명은 의식불명인 상태로 발견된다.
가까스로 구조된 생존자 5명은 그곳에서 있었던 일을 숨기려 하는데... 생존자인 척 숨어있던 살인자에 대한 정황이 드러나기 시작한다.
수사팀은 이 밀실살인 사건의 처음과 끝을 파헤치게 된다.
2020 지상최대공모전 1기 대상 수상작.

Jia was always a nice-mannered girl, but that didn?t stop her from yelling at the cool and distant Jaehee in high school. Now 9 years later, Jaehee wants to spend more time with his first love. description.en: Our demon is forgetful?!

One might think being engaged to Hadius Myer, the son of one of the most prestigious families in the kingdom, sounds like a fairy tale, but for Emilia Bern, a commoner, her reality is nothing but a nightmare. Tired of the constant criticism she receives from other nobles and her fiancé’s cold attitude, all Emilia wants now is to end this charade. But when Hadius turns 19, his attitude suddenly changes. The truth is, Hadius has always been in love with Emilia, but he has been keeping his distance from her because of his unstable position within his family. Unfortunately, Hadius has already lost Emilia’s trust and must prove his sincerity to gain it back. Will the two be able to overcome adversity and hardship and find a way to be together?

A struggling cupid candidate Taehwa goes through series of tests to finally become a cupid but his troubling past is holding him back. His test partner Danbaek, an elite student, dismisses Taehwa for being a bad student but finds out the true story of Taehwa and how he became a cupid candidate...
description.es-la: Taehwa, un candidato a cupido en apuros, pasa por una serie de pruebas para finalmente convertirse en cupido, pero su inquietante pasado lo está frenando. Su compañero de prueba, Danbaek, un estudiante de élite, descarta a Taehwa por ser un mal estudiante, pero descubre la verdadera historia de Taehwa y cómo se convirtió en candidato a Cupido …

description.en: Through the daily life of the two main characters and the people around them, they slowly talk about the past and the present.

Gehan is a college student with special ability: he can see the future through his dreams. One day, he wakes up from a dream about a man colliding with a car accident. Jehan feels it is his responsibility to help this person, but he couldn't see his face. Try to get rid of his frustration by drinking coffee in the café near the campus, only to realize that the barista is the man of his dream. Will Jehan be able to save him?

Kang Han-Se and Ban Ha-Da have known each other ever since childhood. They are close enough to sleep in the same room together at their current age.  
  
"Three men for you," Kang Han-Se's mother tells Ban Ha-Da, on the day of graduation. As soon as Ban Ha-Da's life as a high school student starts, her love life begins as well.

"Yeon Hong" is a disgrace to her boyfriend by making all kinds of incidents such as accidents, gambling, wind, and diving.  
What's wrong with you? I've seen your physiognomy, and you already have a husband?!  
You mean I have to go back to my ex-boyfriend? Find Hong's husband who wants to find one person to be with forever!
After witnessing her father dragged off by a loan shark and found dead, Da Ra Ji is determined to do justice to those people who killed her father.

It was a usual day for Yu Hui-Ne, a color blind girl.  
  
A usual black & white day.  
  
But now, she can see colors for the first time.  
  
Note: This webcomic is likely discontinued. Although the author completed Season 1, Season 2 was never started, even after three years.

C'était un jour habituel pour Yu Hui-Ne, une daltonienne. Un jour noir et blanc habituel. Mais maintenant, elle peut voir les couleurs pour la première fois.

description.en: Ned, an easy going, simple minded guy travels around the world in order to retrieve his scattered memory pieces, along with a short-tempered talking stuffed rabbit. However there are some people called "Chasers" who target Ned and constantly becoming obstacle for their mission. The thrilling chase begins, unraveling the many secrets of the world.

Spirits that eat people's words - UnLeong. In return, they make people's wishes come true.  
Oh Sung is an UnLeongist who counsel others who have wishes that cannot come true unless UnLeong help them.

Due to the penalty of reckless hunting, his grandfather, who is the president of the Vampire Association, imprisons him along with the victim Seo-Yeon, who plays the role of a blood supplier. Hyun-Jae is a vampire and Seoyeon is a human. What is their living together that doesn't match..?

description.en:
Yoon Hyesung is just your average office worker — but in her heart, she’s the number-one fan of Na Yeonwoo, a trainee who keeps getting this close to debuting before every opportunity falls through. 

After yet another failed debut, Hyesung has a full-on meltdown in her room, bawling about the unfair system and her own helplessness.  But when she wakes up, she finds herself in a mysterious space with a strange window popping up: 

[Would you like to accept a reality where your dreams come true?] 

This must be one of those setups, right? but after a brief internal panic, Hyesung makes up her mind.

Although Gyu Hwa Lee might look like a guy, she has feelings like any other girl. In fact, she's currently in love with Korean pop idol Kang Un Ryu. As luck would have it, Kang Un ends up transferring to Gyu Hwa's high school. The only problem is he has to keep his identity a secret so he's cross-dressing as a girl!  
  
What happens when Gyu Hwa discovers Kang Un's secret? Will she ever be able to win over his heart? Or will she always be nothing more than just a friend?

En un día tranquilo, Kaisel, un demonio que se ha aburrido, de repente escucha una voz absurda
de un sacerdote que vino a visitarlo para pedirle una relación. A diferencia de su fuerte ambición de abandonar su virginidad, Kaisel, quien estaba interesado en el sacerdote que no tenía conocimiento de sexo, dijo que le enseñaría paso a paso del uno al diez... “ Sacrificaré este cuerpo para conceder tu deseo. ”

description.en: Four years after the incidents of Timing a new mystery arises that presents new dangers to those who are still left alive.

“Stop crying.”

Yeomra wiped Gung’s tears with his large hands. He frowned as he saw the teardrops trickle onto his fingers. He could not believe what he had done. He felt that the teardrops falling onto the floor were a waste and unconsciously reached out his hand. His actions were unexplainable.

But that was not the only strange thing.

“What is this stinging pain…?”

Every look at the child made his heart hurt. Yeomra could not help but be confused by this pain he had never felt in his entire life. But oddly enough, he couldn’t take his eyes off that child.

Yeoho, the secret guard of the great king, Yeomra, who had watched everything unfold, was in utter panic.

“H-heaven and earth will turn upside down!”

Yeoho looked at his master with a bewildered expression.

Yeoho was wondering whether or not to pluck both of his eyes out. He could not comprehend why his master had acted like that.
So Young meets an alien prince. He needs a human woman and has a proposal for her. What will happen to So Young if she accepts his proposal?

A mysterious camera that shows the future. Ghost lights of unknown origin. And people slipping into unexplainable comas. This is all the information detective Seo Sungmin has as he pieces together the mystery of his girlfriend’s vegetative state. But investigations hit a standstill when he’s found with blood on his hands… Now on the run, will Sungmin be able to solve this supernatural case and bring the real criminal to justice?

description.en: Sir William is a young Englishman who is bored of his stuffy life, and dreams of traveling to the mysterious East, and a life of action and adventure. His mother, however, has grown tired of his fantasies, and now William is in danger of getting married, and never being able to see the wonders of the world! With the help of his Japanese friend Yan, William sneaks on to a Dutch ship that’s heading for Nagasaki, Japan…But he doesn’t even know how long it will take to get there. Then, the ship hits a storm and William, trapped in his hiding place, is thrown overboard. He wakes up to find a girl with curious eyes standing over him…

As the daughter of an old newspaper distribution center, Hye-jin dreamed of becoming a reporter because she grew up surrounded by newspapers. She is an outstanding reporter for a prestigious school newspaper. She wanted to deal with various issues at the school, but the school newspaper collapsed and told Hye-jin that if she failed to cover 'My School's Pretty Boy', the paper newspaper would be closed. The subject of the interview is Hanseong, the captain of the rugby club who is known for being rough! Will Hyejin be able to successfully interview and save the school newspaper?

"In a Fight, they say that the first one to bleed from his or her nose is the loser. Father, Mother and Brother…They're all LOSERS that bled from the nose facing that damn monster called WORLD!  
  
I'm not going to fall into that one. Even though I have to break my head, I'm not going to bow my head before anyone. I'm going to finish everyone! I'm going to throw everyone on the ground with the "Ushi Mata".   
Even though my opponent is…a GIRL"   
  
The Boy that doesn't bow his head to anyone…

It’s fun, but…They’re gay after all! You probably aren’t interested in me, right? Of course I’m not interested either. Have a nice date, guys! I will have fun at school with my friends! However…

“Sophia Serin! Let’s compete!”

“Senior Serin, hello.”

“It looks confused. I helped, right?”

“Come here, Poppy. hand.”

A former gangster, a passionate prosecutor, a magical genius student council president, musician twins, a prince pretending to be a commoner, etc. You are all fish in the bag. Aiden’s fishery! Why are you interested in me and not my childhood friend?

A girl is saved by a fox and goes on an extraordinary adventure.  
  
Was rebooted after chapter four.

Struggling actor Hyeonsu Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeonsu channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

Jae-in is a typical middle school girl obsessed with beauty and makeup and wishes to become a makeup artist. 

One day, she finds a mysterious lipstick by chance, which leads to the opening of a mysterious portal that warps her to a different dimension. When she wakes up the next moment, she realizes she has become a princess of a different world!

Stuck in this mysterious world, will Jae-in be able to find a way out? Or better yet, will she be able to pursue her passion for beauty and live the life she could never live before?

모든 게 완벽한 초절정 미녀 로에멘델의 공주 제인 리샤르 도트리슈가 되어버렸다.
게다가 황태자와의 결혼이라니..! 
다시 현생으로 돌아갈 유일한 열쇠인 립스틱을 의지하며 방법을 모색해 나가지만,
돌아오라는 건 안 돌아오고 얼굴만 다시 돌아와버린 재인!
손에 쥔 신비한 립스틱과 그동안 쌓아올린 메이크업 실력으로 황실 생활 속 고난과 역경을 헤쳐나가는데..
장점은 살리고 단점은 커버하는 진짜 메이크업을 보여준다!

description.en: A seemly perfect man, Y-rul, decides to become a priest to repent and escape his broken past where he lost his true love, Shio. But fate is cruel and Y-rul and Shio meet again two weeks before her wedding to another man. Their passion and love for each other is evident but the restraints that exist in their current lives as well as the pain of the past, may be too much for them to overcome.

altTitles.en: I Will Go Till The End

description.en:
After killing someone in a drunk driving accident, crooked detective Gunsoo Ko hides the body inside her mother’s casket. But when a mysterious caller claims knowledge of the murder and demands the body back, Gunsoo finds herself embroiled in a corruption scandal far worse than she ever imagined.

Based on a movie by the same name directed by Kim Seong-hun
description.ru: По дороге на похороны матери детектив отдела специальных преступлений Ко Гон-су сбивает человека. Произошедшая авария может мгновенно поставить крест на её карьере, разрушив всю жизнь. Чтобы скрыть преступление, она принимает не самое блестящее решение, которое запустит цепочку не самых приятных для полицейского событий.

description.en: A professional killer finds a cute pet sitting in front of his house. But there seems to be a secret behind that cute face...

Choi Yul and I like Han Taekyung as 'us.'

Joonhee has a crush on his childhood friend Taekyung.
By chance, he realizes that his classmate Choi Yul also likes Taekyung...
"I... need someone to like Han Taekyung with!"
"Okay, then let's like him together."
But Joonhee is increasingly bothered by Yul.
The fresh, bittersweet story of Yeon Joonhee’s unrequited love.
description.ko:
최 율과 내가 좋아하는
'우리'의 한태경

소꿉친구인 태경을 짝사랑하는 준희.
우연히 같은 반 최 율이 태경을 좋아한다는 걸 알게 되는데...

"나... 같이 한태경 좋아할 사람이 필요해!"
"그래, 그럼 같이 좋아하자."

하지만 준희는 점점 율이 신경 쓰인다.
풋풋하고, 쌉싸름한 연준희의 짝사랑 이야기.

description.en:
Lee Kyun, the Shepherd, is at the top of the pyramid of the Carnivore Class. Everything was perfect - other than the fact that he has a crush on his best friend, Choi Hae Beom, the Leopard. Too scared to confess, he thought he would be satisfied with just the title of "Best Friend," when a bottom-of-the-food-chain, zero-attack-power Golden Hamster appears and starts to show interest in Hae Beom. Between the two of them, who will manage to capture the Leopard's heart?!

#BL #ShortSeries #Cute #Sweet #SchoolSetting #Hybrids #UnrequitedLove #LoveTriangle #NiceTop #CuteBottom

Boy-crazy Jae Yoo is willing to go through any underhanded means if it means living in the boarding house full of hot guys… Even if it’s going out on a blind date with the dorkiest boy in the school. When she dumps the guy immediately after, she pisses off his handsome best friend Ji Hu and from that point on, the two are constantly going at each other’s throats like cats and dogs. When Jae Yoo finally accomplishes her dream of entering the “boarding house of hunks,” she thinks that nothing could go wrong. An amazing house, a kind landlady, and even a cute guy who seems to be interested in her… What’s this?! Ji Hu is the landlady’s son?! And how is it that he knows about Jae Yoo’s most embarrassing moment in life? What kind of life will the two lead under the same roof? Will they be able to live together at all?!

title.ko-ro: The Villainess I Possessed Is Raising Hell

description.en:
Isabella Dunkeld is a notorious evil woman, hated by her family and scorned by everyone. 

But things take a strange turn when a powerful demon lord from the demon realm finds herself trapped in her body.

The demon has no memory of making a contract with Isabella, yet here she is, stuck and powerless. 

To avoid revealing her true identity, she must act as human as possible.

A young unemployed man named 'Iri' becomes a goblin hunter by chance. As he hunts evil goblins disguised as humans, he gradually awakens the power of his 'blue soul'... His bloody battle to protect the city begins against the ultimate goblin that threatens the human world with a goblin's bat.

description.en: Eunsang Lee is a student who is always bullied and beaten by students at his school. Armed with courage and determination, he joined the television show 'Coming Fist' and became a student of Korea's best UFC athlete, Beomchan Choi. After completing the event, Eunsang Lee returns to school and is ready to avenge the students who bullied him, one by one!
